tagline: A leading European real estate company focused on office, residential and hotel assets in prime locations across Germany, Netherlands and London
hero_kpi_rationale: Like-for-like rental revenue is the primary indicator of organic growth in listed real estate, reflecting the ability to increase rents across a comparable portfolio. It is the fundamental driver of long-term value.

kpis.name: Comparable Rental Growth
kpis.explanation: Increase in rents on comparable properties year-on-year.
kpis.description: Comparable rental growth stabilized at 3.0% in 2025, driven by contractual rent revisions and low vacancy.
kpis.signal: Solid organic growth despite economic headwinds

kpis.name: Net Rental Income
kpis.explanation: Income generated from rents after direct operating expenses.
kpis.description: Net rental income amounted to €1.183 billion in 2025, in line with the previous year.
kpis.signal: Stability in rental income despite market pressures

kpis.name: Funds From Operations (FFO I)
kpis.explanation: Key real estate performance metric, adjusted from IFRS to reflect recurring cash flows.
kpis.description: FFO I reached €288 million in 2025, down 9% year-on-year.
kpis.signal: Slight decline in FFO I due to one-off charges

kpis.name: FFO I per share
kpis.explanation: Funds from operations divided by the number of shares.
kpis.description: FFO I per share declined to €0.26 in 2025, down 10% year-on-year.
kpis.signal: Decline in FFO I per share reflecting lower operational performance

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Operating profit adjusted for non-recurring items.
kpis.description: Adjusted EBITDA amounted to €999 million, a slight decrease of 1%.

kpis.name: Value of Investment Properties
kpis.explanation: Total value of the real estate portfolio assessed by independent appraisers.
kpis.description: The value of investment properties stands at €25 billion, up 5% compared to end-2024.

kpis.name: Loan-to-Value Ratio (LTV)
kpis.explanation: Net debt divided by the value of real estate assets.
kpis.description: LTV stood at 41% in December 2025, down one percentage point from 2024.

kpis.name: Cost of Debt
kpis.explanation: Average interest rate paid on debt.
kpis.description: Average cost of debt remains stable at 2.3%, supported by ECB rate cuts.
kpis.signal: Benefiting from declining interest rate environment

kpis.name: Share of Green Certifications
kpis.explanation: Proportion of assets certified as sustainable or green.
kpis.description: 70% of commercial assets now hold a green certification, up 23 percentage points from 2024.
kpis.signal: Accelerating green transition of the commercial portfolio

kpis.name: Unencumbered Investment Properties
kpis.explanation: Value of assets not pledged as collateral against debt.
kpis.description: The value of unencumbered investment properties amounts to €17.0 billion, representing 70% of the total portfolio value.
kpis.signal: Strong balance sheet with 70% of assets unencumbered, providing financing flexibility

ai_positioning.summary: Aroundtown SA does not mention any strategy or initiative related to artificial intelligence in its recent financial or operational documents.
evidence: No mention of AI in operational highlights
No references to AI tools for property management
Absence of data on automation or predictive analytics
